items.text:
Build Tools/Rad/Fans
About to start getting things for my 2nd build, wondering if anyone knows a decent/affordable tool kit for PC building.

Also I'm going to be using a Phanteks P350x Case for my build and was thinking of putting x2 140mm intakes in the front, x2 140mm exhaust on the top and a Corsair H60 AIO cooling and hopefully mount it in the back to exhaust. My question is that if this is a good idea? For fans I'll be getting Noctua Redux. Any suggestions? 

Thank you all in advance!
